title: Concept: Cargo dependency declared with a wildcard
description: Cargo.toml declares a `version = "*"` dependency, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Cargo resolves the newest release of any major line, so a breaking or compromised publish installs with no manifest change.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: Cargo resolves the newest release of any major line, so a breaking or compromised publish installs with no manifest change.
